provenance.samplers: Unmodified CenteredFeatureNoise and ShoreNoise classes from mapped Core jar; metadata-only biome/source stubs; original TFGCellular2D, TFC OpenSimplex2D, Seed/Xoroshiro, and Minecraft Mth loaded from jars.
provenance.heightMeaning: Centered rawHeight is original sampler output (Integer.MIN_VALUE means absent); appliedHeight matches TFGChunkHeightFiller sentinel handling for the constant single-feature profile: rawHeight when present, otherwise preHeight. Shore columnHeight and tideLevel come from original Java samplers; tideStageHeight applies TFGChunkHeightFiller ocean-edge clamp using Minecraft Mth. Shore `shoreBaseHeight` is the absolute tfg$getShoreBaseHeight getter passed to the original sampler. `classic_raw_offset_*` preserve synthetic direct-getter stress cases; `classic_getter_*` use runtime getter values produced by SEA_LEVEL_Y + raw biome offsets. Non-finite shore returns are JSON strings. Classic pure-shore corners return original heightIn after the internal 0/0 expression becomes NaN.
